Most of 1st and 2nd level titles have "Requirements" at the end of title, except:
```
grep -r "## V" 4.0/en/ | grep -v " Requirements$" | cut -d' ' -f2-
V4.1 General Access Control Design
V4.2 Operation Level Access Control
V4.3 Other Access Control Considerations
V8.1 General Data Protection
V8.2 Client-side Data Protection
V8.3 Sensitive Private Data
V14.1 Build
V14.2 Dependency

V6.2 Algorithms

V6.4 Secret Management
V3.4 Cookie-based Session Management
V3.5 Token-based Session Management
V3.6 Re-authentication from a Federation or Assertion
V3.7 Defenses Against Session Management Exploits
V7.4 Error Handling
```

Just pointing it out.

comments.body:
And similar question - should all requirements start with "Verify that"? 46 requirements start with just verify.

```
$ grep -r "** | Verify" 4.0/en/ | grep -v "** | Verify that" | grep "4.0/en/0x1" | cut -d'|' -f2-3
```

I think the word "Requirements" is redundant throughout all of these headings. Please you open a PR to remove for both 4.0.2 and 4.1.

They verify thing will vary between requirements so I prefer to leave that for now.

and if "Verification Requirements" is at the end, then I guess there is need to remove "Verification" also, not only Requirements. 

Example
> V3 Session Management Verification Requirements

Will be
> V3 Session Management

@tghosth , I started to remove those " Requirements" and " Verification Requirements", but I think some titles need to have language fixes also after that, so I better don't touch them.

For example, "## V1.2 Authentication Architectural Requirements" without "Requirements" is "## V1.2 Authentication Architectural" is a bit "not finished". Probably it must be "## V1.2 Authentication Architecture" or something. Anyway, I would not like to take on me anything which requires correct English and wordsmithing.

To be 100% sure about this change I would like to get confirmation.

Current titles:
```
#V1 Architecture, Design and Threat Modeling Requirements
#V2 Authentication Verification Requirements
#V3 Session Management Verification Requirements
#V4 Access Control Verification Requirements
#V5 Validation, Sanitization and Encoding Verification Requirements
#V6 Stored Cryptography Verification Requirements
#V7 Error Handling and Logging Verification Requirements
#V8 Data Protection Verification Requirements
#V9 Communications Verification Requirements
#V10 Malicious Code Verification Requirements
#V11 Business Logic Verification Requirements
#V12 File and Resources Verification Requirements
#V13 API and Web Service Verification Requirements
#V14 Configuration Verification Requirements
```

New titles:
```
#V1 Architecture, Design and Threat Modeling
#V2 Authentication
#V3 Session Management
#V4 Access Control
#V5 Validation, Sanitization and Encoding
#V6 Stored Cryptography
#V7 Error Handling and Logging
#V8 Data Protection
#V9 Communications
#V10 Malicious Code
#V11 Business Logic
#V12 File and Resources
#V13 API and Web Service
#V14 Configuration
```

For speedup some hilights - @tghosth @jmanico @vanderaj

I prefer the concise version although pushing this into 4.0.2 runs the risk of breaking a lot of process and systems who currently use the older verbose headings. 

I think this is more of a major change than minor, a change I'd like to see
@elarlang I am going to push this to 4.1 given @danielcuthbert's concern that it is a breaking change
Id like to see a PR for this and get it into main please, Elar's rename looks solid.

@tghosth @danielcuthbert @vanderaj 
Would like to get feedback, is change ok for 4.1 or it should be milestoned to 5.0?
@elarlang please open a PR, it would be good to get this done now.

Current format for first level title is with `:` after "identifier" and for second level there is no `:`. Is there some clear point for this `:` or we can get rid of this?

I updated titles based on comments. There are at least 3 subcategories (V3.7, V4.2, V7.2), which are not clear at the moment for me and I think those needs some improvement. As discussion of the category title meaning is different from general name correction, I'll open separate issues for those in the future - those are not just category name questions.

For 3.7 how about : V3.7 User Re-authentication
For 4.2 I suggest we drop the category and merge those items into 4.3 (other)
For 7.2 I suggest we drop the category and merge those items into 7.1 (Log Content)

Just "User Re-authentication" sounds really like some V2 subcategory, not related to session. Old name "V3.7 Defenses Against Session Management Exploits" actually describe it well. Just it contains only one requirement.

4.2 and 7.2 are a bit bigger changes and need to discuss separately.

> Old name "V3.7 Defenses Against Session Management Exploits" actually describe it well. Just it contains only one requirement.

This is a long name, overly wordy, and all of 3x is about that so I do not like the current title.

How about "Other Session Management Considerations"?

if you check this requirement text, it's not really session management in my opinion. It may fit even to business logic cateogry.

From this issue point of view, it does not matter too much, what will be this category name, because goal from this issue is to remove "Requirements" and "Verification Requirements" from titles. I'll open separate issues for those - but if I have enough time to prepare some initial proposal also.
Sounds good!
